title: Henri de Rivel Pro Mono Crown Fancy Padded Bridle, Havana, Oversize
writeup: The Henri de Rivel Pro Mono Crown Fancy padded bridle in Havana, oversize (model 5099-03O, UPC 849913025140) is $71.99 on Woot with only one left. Country Supply, State Line Tack, and HDR's own store all list the matching Havana/Oversize variant at $119.99, so this clears exactly 40% below those live tags. Specs match across stores: contoured padded mono crown, fancy-stitched browband and noseband, stainless hardware, and 5/8-inch laced reins. Condition could not be read from the Woot offer page (403); feed marked it new.
